title: Short-Term Distribution Is Not Durable Food Security
summary: From emergency delivery through rights, affordability, production, institutions, repair, replenishment, adaptation, and long-horizon security.
map_question: What records are required before short-term distribution is not durable food security can support a bounded food-system decision?
interpretation_boundary: This map does not establish production, provisioning, access, nutrition, reserve, contamination, circularity, resource security, remedy, score, rank, or receipt.

what_this_map_supports: Separate production, land, water, provisioning, procurement, access, nutrition, reserve, safety, circularity, and security decisions.
Explicit authority, affected publics, capacity, safeguards, distribution, challenge, and review.
Public reasoning without household or community scoring or ranking.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not allocate land, water, food, benefits, contracts, inventory, reserves, or remedies.
It does not convert availability, inventory, local output, procurement spend, diversion, or short-term distribution into security.
It does not create a receipt, score, rank, stage advance, or operating-outcome change.
